Native-only strings are in native-only.md. tests/app/uiSpecVectors.test.ts checks that every entry still occurs in src/app. Some entries are fragments the web UI concatenates (e.g. sourceDetail.deleteModal.*); for translation, native clients should turn each assembled sentence into one string with placeholders.
